items.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Lands $20 Billion Mandate As Dealmaking Hits Record Levels
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) and Qatar Investment Authority agreed a US$20b multi market investment partnership covering public equities and private credit. The alliance is led by J.P. Morgan Asset Management and allocates capital across several regions and asset classes for QIA. JPMorgan executives highlighted record global dealmaking and resilient M&A and IPO activity despite macroeconomic headwinds in recent commentary. items.title: Meta AI agent triggers heavy selloff in banks, insurers, and travel stocks
items.summary: Investing.com -- A sudden artificial intelligence breakthrough is reshaping Wall Street. Financials, travel, and telecom stocks tumbled Tuesday as investors fear Meta’s new Muse AI agent will eliminate customer friction—the long-standing habit of sticking with overpriced or underperforming services simply to avoid the hassle of switching. Disruption Across Habit-Driven Industries The aggressive sector rotation stems from the rapid ascent of Meta’s Muse, which recently hit No. 1 on Apple’s US App
